auth.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask the school administration to reset it.

dashboard.setupText: Follow these steps once. You can introduce the system gradually, for example one section or one class at a time.
dashboard.setup1: Create the school year, terms, sections, subjects and classes
dashboard.setup2: Create accounts for teachers and staff
dashboard.setup3: Add students to their classes and link parents
dashboard.setup5: Enter or import the yearly plans
dashboard.noClassesToday: You have no classes on the timetable today.
dashboard.noChildren: No child is linked to your account yet. Please contact the school administration.
dashboard.financeLater: The finance module is not switched on yet. It is planned for a later phase.

teaching.noSlots: No classes are on the timetable for this day.

help.held: The lesson took place as planned.
help.missed: The lesson did not take place (teacher absent, etc.).
help.cancelled: Cancelled by the school (event, exam, etc.).
help.makeup: An extra lesson that replaces a missed one.

teaching.makeupFor: Makes up for the lesson of
teaching.recordExtra: Record a make-up or extra lesson
teaching.recordExtraHelp: Choose the class. Lessons on the timetable are recorded from the 'Classes by day' page.
teaching.historyKept: The previous values will be kept in the change history.
teaching.corrected: The correction has been saved. The previous values are kept in the history.
teaching.alreadyRecorded: this lesson has already been recorded for this date
teaching.dateNotOnTimetable: this class is not on the timetable on this date

hours.title: Teaching hours
hours.how: Scheduled hours come from the timetable for each week of the term, up to the selected date, minus school closures. Held, missed, cancelled and make-up hours come from the lessons recorded by teachers or administrators. 'Lessons not recorded' counts timetable lessons for which nothing has been entered yet. Taught hours = held + make-up.
hours.empty: No teaching assignments match these filters.

progress.title: Lesson progress
progress.explain: 'Planned' counts the lessons the yearly plan expects to be reached by the selected date. 'Taught' counts lessons marked completed.
progress.noPlanLong: There is no yearly plan for this level and subject yet. An administrator can create or import one.
progress.planVsActual: Plan compared with what was taught
progress.noEntries: No progress has been recorded yet.

plans.title: Yearly plans
plans.intro: A yearly plan lists the chapters and lessons for one section, level and subject, with the date by which each lesson should be reached. Each section can have its own plan.
plans.empty: No yearly plans have been created for this school year yet.
plans.created: The plan has been created. You can now add chapters and lessons, or import them.
plans.exists: a plan already exists for this section, level and subject
plans.levelHelp: Use exactly the same level name as the classes (for example 'Form 4' or 'Seconde C').
plans.noChapters: This plan has no chapters yet.
plans.noLessons: No lessons in this chapter yet.
plans.confirmDeleteChapter: Delete this chapter and all its lessons? This cannot be undone.
plans.confirmDeleteLesson: Delete this lesson? This cannot be undone.
plans.lessonInUse: This cannot be deleted because teachers have already recorded progress on it.
plans.importHelp: Copy the columns from Excel or a CSV file and paste them below: chapter, lesson, planned date (DD/MM/YYYY), hours, term (optional). Lessons are added after the existing ones. Nothing is imported if a row has an error.
plans.importEmpty: Nothing to import: the box is empty.
plans.importRowMissing: Row {row}: the chapter and lesson are required.
plans.importRowDate: Row {row}: the date is not valid (use DD/MM/YYYY).
plans.importRowHours: Row {row}: the number of hours is not valid.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.noClasses: You have no classes for this school year.
attendance.noStudents: No students are enrolled in this class yet.
attendance.helpDefault: Everyone is marked present. Change only the students who are absent, late or excused, then save.
attendance.alreadyTaken: Attendance has already been taken for this date. Any change you save is kept in the history.
attendance.badDate: Choose a valid date that is not in the future.
attendance.legend: P = present · A = absent · L = late · E = excused

absences.title: Repeated absences and lateness
absences.explain: Students with at least {n} absences or lates in the last {days} days.
absences.none: No student has reached this level of absence.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.empty: There are no announcements at the moment.
announcements.bilingualHelp: Write the announcement in French, English or both. Readers see their own language when it is available.
announcements.visibilityHelp: The announcement is only visible after the 'Visible from' time (school time, {tz}) and is hidden after the 'Hide after' time.
announcements.confirmPublish: Publish this announcement? It will be visible to the selected people from the chosen time.
announcements.savedDraft: Draft saved. It is not visible to anyone yet.
announcements.archived: The announcement has been archived and is no longer visible.
announcements.confirmArchive: Archive this announcement? Readers will no longer see it.
announcements.needTitle: write a title in at least one language
announcements.needAudience: choose who can see the announcement
announcements.expiryAfterPublish: the hide time must be after the visible-from time
announcements.otherLanguageOnly: This announcement is only available in the other language.

outbox.title: Prepared SMS messages
outbox.help: Messages prepared for parents, waiting for an SMS or WhatsApp service.
outbox.notConnected: No SMS or WhatsApp service is connected. These messages have NOT been sent. They are kept here so they can be sent once the school connects a provider.
outbox.prepared: SMS texts have been prepared for the parents concerned. They have not been sent.

students.noRecord: Your account is not linked to a student record yet. Please contact the school administration.
students.attendanceHidden: The school has not made attendance visible here.
students.noAttendance: No attendance has been recorded this year.

students.marksLater: Marks and report cards will be added in a later phase.

admin.title: Administration
admin.structureHelp: School years, terms, closures, sections, subjects and classes.
admin.structureIntro: Set up the school year first, then terms, sections, subjects and classes. Nothing is hard-coded: use your school's own names.
admin.usersHelp: Teachers, parents, administrators and finance staff.
admin.studentsHelp: Add students, place them in classes and link parents.
admin.timetableHelp: Who teaches what to which class, and when.
admin.timetableIntro: First assign a teacher to a class and subject, then add that lesson's weekly times for each term.
admin.settingsHelp: School name, language, time zone, currency, alerts and what parents and students can see.
admin.announcementsHelp: Publish notices for teachers, students and parents.
admin.noYears: No school year yet. Create the first one below.
admin.confirmCurrent: Make {name} the current school year for everyone?
admin.termsHelp: Terms must fall within the school year dates.
admin.termOutsideYear: The term dates must be inside the school year.
admin.closuresHelp: Days without classes. They are not counted as scheduled teaching hours.
admin.noClasses: No classes for this year yet.
admin.createYearFirst: Please create a school year first.
admin.addUserHelp: A temporary password is created. Give it to the person privately; they must change it the first time they sign in. Student accounts are created from the Students page.
admin.tempPasswordHelp: Write this down and give it to the person privately. It will not be shown again. They will choose their own password at first sign-in.
admin.usernameFormat: 3 to 40 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores, without spaces
admin.createStudentsFromStudentsPage: create student accounts from the Students page
admin.deactivateHelp: An inactive account cannot sign in. Its records are kept.
admin.cannotDeactivateSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account.
admin.resetHelp: Creates a new temporary password and signs the person out on all devices.
admin.confirmReset: Reset this person's password? Their current password will stop working.
admin.noLinkedChildren: No child is linked to this parent.
admin.linkFromStudent: To link a child, open the student's page.
admin.privacyNote: Record only what the school needs. Do not enter real student information until the school has confirmed its data-protection and child-safeguarding rules.
admin.createStudentLogin: Also create a student login (username = 's' + student number)
admin.minimalData: Only the name, student number and class are needed. Avoid storing extra personal details.
admin.confirmMove: Move this student to the selected class? Past attendance is kept.
admin.guardianHelp: A parent can only see the children linked here.
admin.unlinked: The parent is no longer linked to this student.
admin.confirmUnlink: Unlink this parent? They will no longer see this child's information.
admin.addAssignment: Assign a teacher to a class and subject
admin.slotClash: This time overlaps another lesson of the same teacher or class.
admin.slotInUse: This time slot already has recorded lessons, so it cannot be deleted.

settings.currencyHelp: 3-letter code, e.g. XAF. Used by the finance module later.
settings.prepare_sms_for_absences: Also prepare an SMS text (not sent until an SMS service is connected)
settings.smsHelp: No SMS or WhatsApp service is connected yet. Prepared messages are listed under 'Prepared SMS messages' and marked 'Not sent'.

settings.show_attendance_to_students: Students can see their own attendance
settings.show_progress_to_students: Students and parents can see where the class is in each subject

audit.title: Change history
audit.help: Every creation and correction is recorded with the person and the time. Records are never silently overwritten.
